confidential: INTERNAL ONLY. Never send to a customer or partner. No prices in any output; no users per module.
rules: The SC lists WHICH products are needed and the gotchas. The AE and Deal Desk own price and user counts (log item 74, 13 Nov 2026).
Unlimited is the default since 1 May 2026. Per seat only when the customer can't accept Unlimited: record why.
The tier is a candidate only. Deal Desk validates it; the CEO approves every Unlimited quote before any number is shared.
Every Yes or TBC line has a reason (a requirement, pain or demo scene) and an evidence tag C/P/I/A.
Qty only for non-user items (blocks, GB, environments). Never a dollar amount.
OPEN items are Deal Desk questions: show them as OPEN, never pick an answer.

sources.name: Studio Creatio Platform Plans PDF v5 (creatio.com)

open_items.text: Unlimited AI allowance: 500 AI actions one-time (FY27 deck) vs 10,000 AI credits per organisation (10x deck, public sheet).
Unlimited storage: 2 GB x tier max employees (FY27 deck) vs 'unlimited / extended storage included' (public sheet). Use the internal figure until confirmed.
SKU names for the VPN tunnel and the hosting region; CRM app editions (public configurator unreadable).
AI credit block price for Scale differs between the 10x deck and the website. Not used in the BOM.

requires.why: AI Platform is mandatory with Studio (G05)
Support is mandatory for the whole term (G17)
Unlimited must attach an AI Package (P1 note)
Credit blocks sit on top of a package
Unlimited and per seat are alternatives

tiers_notes: Source: FY27 Unlimited Pricing Model deck, slides 6-7. Tier = highest of revenue (or AUM) and employees. Upper bounds in USD millions.
Storage: 2 GB database + 2 GB attachment storage x the tier's maximum employees (FY27 deck s6). OPEN: the public plan sheet says 'extended storage included'. Deal Desk to confirm.
storage_rule: Unlimited: 2 GB database + 2 GB file storage x the tier's max employees (OPEN-2).

skus.name: Creatio Unlimited Platform
skus.note: Default model since 1 May 2026. Must attach an AI Package. Minimum term 3 years. Tier validated by Deal Desk; every quote CEO-approved.
skus.consider_when: Every new deal by default (Unlimited since 1 May 2026).

skus.name: Creatio Studio (Platform)
skus.note: Per seat only when Unlimited can't be accepted. Growth: cloud only, 2 environments, 50 roles, no SSO / LDAP / audit log / custom branding. Users start at 5.
skus.source: Platform plans PDF; FY27 deck s9
skus.consider_when: Only when the customer can't accept Unlimited; record why on the deal.

skus.name: Creatio AI Platform
skus.note: MANDATORY with Studio: same quantity, same edition. Upgrading Studio upgrades it. Separate line on the Order Form.
skus.consider_when: Always with P2: same quantity, same edition.

skus.name: Creatio Sales
skus.consider_when: Leads, opportunities, pipeline, quotes, account or intermediary management, field sales.

skus.name: Creatio Marketing
skus.note: Check contact volumes: see Marketing Contacts.
skus.consider_when: Campaigns, email or SMS journeys, events, segmentation, lead nurture.

skus.name: Creatio Marketing Contacts
skus.note: Contact volume for marketing. Ask the size of the marketable database.
skus.consider_when: With C2: the size of the marketable database (emails, SMS).

skus.name: Creatio Service
skus.consider_when: Cases, complaints, hardship, service requests, SLAs, knowledge base, contact centre.

skus.name: Creatio Financial Services CRM
skus.note: Banks, lenders, multi-finance, insurers.
skus.consider_when: Banks, lenders, multi-finance, pawn, securities, insurers: customer 360, applications, loans, onboarding.

skus.name: Creatio External B2C Portal
skus.note: Their customers log in.
skus.consider_when: Their retail customers log in (apply, upload documents, track status).

skus.name: Creatio External B2B Portal
skus.note: Partners, brokers, dealers log in.
skus.consider_when: Brokers, dealers, merchants, distributors or partners log in.

skus.name: Creatio Self-Service Portal
skus.consider_when: Customers raise and track their own requests.

skus.name: Creatio Mobile-only
skus.note: Field users on mobile only.
skus.consider_when: Field staff who only use the mobile app.

skus.name: Creatio Limited Internal
skus.note: Internal users who view or approve.
skus.consider_when: Internal staff who only view, approve or do light updates.

skus.name: Creatio AI Package
skus.note: MANDATORY for any ongoing AI use, also on Unlimited. Not discountable. Credits and advisory hours expire at end of term. Can upgrade, not downgrade, within the term.
skus.consider_when: Any AI scene shown or asked for that goes live (agents, copilots, document reading, summaries, voice).

skus.name: Additional AI credit block (500,000 credits)
skus.note: Buy more without upgrading the package. Not discountable.
skus.consider_when: High AI volumes beyond the package's credits.

skus.name: Freedom package (bring your own LLM, on-prem AI)
skus.note: Only Freedom allows BYO model or on-prem AI. Custom price.
skus.consider_when: They need their own LLM, or AI running on their own servers.

skus.name: Governance Application
skus.note: Paid add-on on Growth and Enterprise.
skus.consider_when: Per seat (Growth/Enterprise) and they need governance of changes and environments.

skus.name: Dedicated cloud instance
skus.note: Enterprise: paid. Growth: not available. Unlimited: blocks by tier (Deal sheet).
skus.source: Platform plans PDF p2; FY27 deck s6
skus.consider_when: Per seat Enterprise and they need a dedicated instance; on Unlimited it comes by tier.

skus.name: Additional dedicated blocks
skus.note: Large volumes, heavy integrations or performance needs beyond the tier's blocks.
skus.consider_when: Very large volumes, heavy integrations or batch loads beyond the tier's blocks.

skus.name: Additional database storage
skus.note: SEPARATE from file storage. Growth 1 GB/user, Enterprise 2 GB/user, Unlimited 2 GB x tier max employees.
skus.source: Platform plans PDF p1; FY27 deck s6
skus.consider_when: Large customer, loan or contact books, or a merge of several books.

skus.name: Additional attachment (file) storage
skus.note: SEPARATE from database storage. Same allowances as database.
skus.source: Platform plans PDF p1; FY27 deck s6
skus.consider_when: Many documents (applications, claims, contracts), large files or long retention.

skus.name: Additional environments
skus.note: Growth 2, Enterprise 3 (prod plus test/dev). Ask how many they need.
skus.consider_when: Per seat and more environments than the edition includes (training, UAT, several dev).

skus.name: Custom domain name
skus.note: Enterprise: paid.
skus.consider_when: Per seat Enterprise and they want their own domain.

skus.name: VPN tunnel (site-to-site)
skus.note: Needed when Creatio cloud must reach on-premises systems. SKU name: confirm with Deal Desk.
skus.consider_when: Creatio cloud must reach on-premises systems directly (core, lending platform, middleware).

skus.name: On-premise deployment
skus.note: Enterprise and Unlimited only. Growth is cloud only. Ask who hosts and supports it.
skus.consider_when: They require on-premises hosting.

skus.name: Hosting region / data residency
skus.note: Confirm the region against the governance pack's 'can say' lines.
skus.consider_when: Data residency rules or a required hosting region.

skus.name: Business support
skus.note: Support is mandatory for the whole term and covers all products.
skus.consider_when: Per seat: the base support plan (mandatory, covers all products).

skus.name: Premium support
skus.source: creatio.com support options; FY27 deck s6
skus.consider_when: Extended hours or faster response needed; included on Unlimited.

skus.name: Creatio Delivery Assurance OR No-Code Magic
skus.note: Unlimited only. Public sheet: No-Code Magic covers implementation of the first project by a certified partner.
skus.source: FY27 deck s6; Platform plans PDF p1
skus.consider_when: Unlimited: choose Delivery Assurance (partner delivery risk, see knowledge/DELIVERY-ASSURANCE-v0.2.md) or No-Code Magic.

skus.note: Paid on Growth and Enterprise.
skus.consider_when: Training and certification for their team; included on Unlimited.

skus.consider_when: As M1.

gotchas.text: Tier = the HIGHEST of revenue (or AUM for BFSI) and employees.
gotchas.question: What are your annual revenue (or AUM) and total employees?

gotchas.text: Holding structure: say which legal entity will use the platform; Deal Desk validates it.
gotchas.question: Which entity signs, and which entities use it?

gotchas.text: Existing customer moving to Unlimited: upgrade price = target Unlimited ARR minus current ARR.
gotchas.question: What do they have today, and when does it renew?

gotchas.text: Unlimited: 3-year minimum; 5% uplift each year from year 2. Standard term is 3 years.
gotchas.question: Is a 3-year term acceptable?
gotchas.source: FY27 deck s9-s10; Platform plans PDF p3

gotchas.text: AI Platform is mandatory with Studio (same quantity, same edition).
An AI Package is mandatory for ongoing AI use, also on Unlimited.
gotchas.question: Which AI use cases go live first, and at what volume?

gotchas.text: AI Packages and credit blocks cannot be discounted. Credits expire at end of the contract term.
Bring your own LLM, or AI on-premises = Freedom package only.
gotchas.question: Do they need their own model, or AI on their own servers?

gotchas.text: OPEN: Unlimited AI allowance. FY27 deck: 500 AI actions one-time. 10x deck and public sheet: 10,000 AI credits per organisation.
gotchas.question: Deal Desk to confirm
gotchas.source: FY27 s6 vs 10x s15, Platform plans PDF p1

gotchas.text: Database and file (attachment) storage are SEPARATE allowances. Large customer bases or document volumes need extra.
gotchas.question: How many customers / records? How many documents, what size, kept how long?
gotchas.source: Platform plans PDF p1; FY27 deck s6; Renzo

gotchas.text: OPEN: public sheet says Unlimited storage is 'unlimited / extended included'; internal FY27 deck says 2 GB DB + 2 GB files x tier max employees. Use the internal figure; Deal Desk to confirm.
gotchas.question: Deal Desk to confirm
gotchas.source: Platform plans PDF p1 vs FY27 deck s6

gotchas.text: Dedicated blocks: included by tier on Unlimited (T1 x1, T2-3 x2, T4-5 x4, T6 2 x (x4), T7 custom). Beyond that is extra.
gotchas.question: Peak users, integration load, batch jobs?

gotchas.text: VPN tunnel needed when Creatio cloud must reach on-premises systems.
gotchas.question: Which systems are on-premises, and must Creatio reach them directly?

gotchas.text: Growth: cloud only, 2 environments, 50 roles, 50K executed process elements a month, 10K API calls per user per day, change log 90 days.
gotchas.question: How many environments, roles and integrations?

gotchas.text: Growth has no SSO, LDAP sync, audit log, custom branding, HIPAA or offline mobile.
gotchas.question: Do they need SSO, audit log or offline mobile?

gotchas.text: Marketplace apps and connectors are never in Unlimited; price on demand needs a partner quote and has its own support terms.
gotchas.question: Which systems must we connect to (telephony, WhatsApp, e-signature, core banking)?
gotchas.source: FY27 deck s13; support options page

gotchas.text: Support is mandatory for the whole term and must cover all products (not part of them).
Unlimited quote flow: Deal Desk tier validation, then Sales Director / CSO, COO (borderline cases), CEO (mandatory). Never share a number before approval.

sizing_questions.question: Annual revenue, or AUM for BFSI (USD)

sizing_questions.ae_wording: Roughly how many employees across the group?

sizing_questions.question: Which legal entity signs and which use it
sizing_questions.why: Deal Desk validates the tier on the right entity
sizing_questions.ae_wording: Which company in the group would sign, and which would use it?

sizing_questions.question: Number of customer / contact records, and growth over 3 years
sizing_questions.ae_wording: How many customer records do you hold today, and how fast is that growing?

sizing_questions.ae_wording: How many documents do you keep per customer, and for how long?

sizing_questions.ae_wording: Cloud, or does it have to run on your own servers?

sizing_questions.ae_wording: How many environments do you usually run (production, test, training)?

sizing_questions.question: AI use cases going live first, and expected volume
sizing_questions.ae_wording: Which AI use cases would you switch on first, and at what volume?
